projection: Same as the daylight pair: top row zenith; phi=(u-.5)*2pi, theta=v*pi.
solarSeparation: Camera-only disc in visible, none in lighting; runtime keeps one directional sun (dusk) or none (night, floodlights only).
originalContent: Procedural atmosphere, clouds, stars and light dome authored for FootballEngine; Blender physical sky, noise and Cycles are tools, not imported assets.
